strings: Upon {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} clanmates' suggestion, m_c goes to see r_c0. r_c0 diagnoses {PRONOUN/m_c/object} with major depressive disorder.
r_c0 helps m_c groom, purring all the while as comfortingly as {PRONOUN/r_c/subject} can. m_c just stares off into the distance, eyes almost seeming empty.
m_c's lasting grief has caused {PRONOUN/m_c/object} to develop major depressive disorder.
m_c has barely been able to leave {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} nest, even refusing food when it is brought to {PRONOUN/m_c/object}. {PRONOUN/m_c/subject/CAP} has major depressive disorder.
m_c's sadness has gone into numbness - something heavy weighs {PRONOUN/m_c/object} down as {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/wander/wanders} listlessly around the camp.

The grief has become something numb, empty almost, as m_c stares at the walls of {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} den. {PRONOUN/m_c/subject/CAP} {VERB/m_c/don't/doesn't} know how {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/are/is} supposed to get up after this.
m_c stalked out of camp, clawing at the ground as {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} went. It was so unfair, all of it, why did StarClan take them away? Why curse {PRONOUN/m_c/object} with this darkness inside?
